fusions.name: Drawn Mesh
fusions.desc: Drags a net of mycelium across the target, dealing 11 damage, stunning it for 1 second and slowing it 30% for 4 seconds. It is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, and you heal for 50% of the damage the poison deals.

fusions.name: Long Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a spore at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Draw Tight
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. While it lasts, a sporeling fights beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged Prey
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, a ward absorbs damage equal to 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
